evidence.description: Confirmed by direct read: DRY = os.getenv('DRY_RUN','true') != 'false' -> defaults to True (DRY) when DRY_RUN is unset, so the DEFAULT path (no env vars set) cannot post an order. This one specific claim in the review request is VERIFIED TRUE.
Confirmed: run.sh's own top-level gate also defaults DRY_RUN=true, EARN_MODE=observe, so run.sh itself will not call order.py in the real branch by default either.

topDefects: FIND-001 (critical): run.sh ignores decide.py's per-window idempotency flag ('recorded') -> will fire a REAL order on every ~1-minute cron tick within the same 5-minute window instead of once, once execution is enabled.

FIND-002 (critical): decide.py always emits the YES/UP token_id even when side='DOWN' -> a DOWN decision would BUY THE WRONG OUTCOME TOKEN at a mismatched (NO) price. Invisible in paper mode because resolve.py's P&L math never checks token_id.

FIND-003 (critical): run.sh never exports PM_PAPER_PASS to order.py's environment, so order.py's own internal 3-gate re-check is either permanently unreachable (dead real-path) or a stale rubber-stamp if an operator statically sets the var -- the advertised 'gate re-checked in order.py' safety property does not hold as wired.

FIND-004 (critical): run.sh shell-interpolates decide.py's JSON (which embeds an untrusted, free-text Polymarket market 'question' string) directly into a Python triple-quoted string literal inside `python3 -c` calls -> a crafted market question can break out and execute arbitrary code in the same process that holds the wallet private key.

FIND-009 (critical): 0 of the 29 passing tests touch order.py, run.sh, or decide.py's main() -- the only file in this slot that moves real money has no automated test coverage at all, including no test of the DRY_RUN default, the token_id-for-DOWN path, or duplicate-window firing.
verificationNote: The specific claim in the review request ("DRY_RUN (default) initialized ClobClient + derived CLOB creds ... and posted NOTHING") was independently re-derived from the code and IS TRUE for the default env (order.py:38, run.sh:12-13). That does not make the executor safe: FIND-001/002/003/004 show that once the three real-mode env vars ARE set (which is the entire point of building this file), the code will duplicate-fire orders, buy the wrong token on DOWN signals, run an effectively decoupled/dead re-check gate, and is exposed to a code-injection path via untrusted market text -- all before a single test exists to catch any of it.
